free_text: The patient is a 71-year-old male with a rising PSA of 13.2 ng/mL and a prior ISUP Grade Group 2 prostate adenocarcinoma. MRI shows a PI-RADS 4 lesion (cT2a) with restricted diffusion, suggesting clinically significant cancer. The management assessment is to review individual treatment benefit and patient preferences, balancing potential oncologic control against treatment risks.
